plan.title: Ordered account lifecycle delivery
plan.summary: Two sequential same-resource implementation work items followed by complete-scope verification and local sandbox delivery.

delivery_scope.inclusion_basis: Entire confirmed account-availability design; no selected-item truncation.

work_items.outcome: Implement account availability, protected admin editing, revocation and additive SQLite migration.
work_items.completion_criteria: Current application code handles enabled status, session revocation and legacy data without broadening access.
work_items.expected_evidence: Immutable source snapshot and syntax/current-content checks.

work_items.outcome: Add reproducible account lifecycle tests and local usage documentation.
work_items.completion_criteria: Executable tests and documentation exist on top of the exact first implementation result.
work_items.expected_evidence: Immutable test source, syntax checks and actual functional test output.

work_items.outcome: Verify and validate the complete current requirement and design scope.
work_items.completion_criteria: All required objectives have current real method evidence with passing verification and validation.
work_items.expected_evidence: Actual current-subject method logs, assertion identities and VFY conclusions.

work_items.outcome: Deliver the verified result to a disposable local sandbox and confirm its exact version.
work_items.completion_criteria: The current VFY-approved candidate is applied to the authorized local target and its version matches.
work_items.expected_evidence: Release effect observation, target version readback and terminal lifecycle status.

lifecycle_applicability.basis: Consume complete design scope and preserve the ordered resource result chain.
